summary.text: Kelly Keisling is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 38, where he has served since 2010, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Keisling is on the ballot with Seth McMillan.

paragraphs.text: Kelly Keisling attended Belmont University and worked in insurance before he was elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives.
From 1994 to 1998 he served as County Executive of Pickett County.
In the 2023–2024 session he chaired the State Government Committee and also sat on the Calendar and Rules and Finance, Ways, and Means committees.
